scope: Pairwise action-ranking objective, default-reference preservation, trainer plumbing, four-arm matched recipe, M0-only release queue and CPU loss witness. Source/CPU gate only; no performance acceptance.

ranking_source_checks.indexing: Flattening [7 regions, 5 candidates, 2 actions] gives 70 actions. Flat index // 10 correctly identifies the region; regular and pause actions retain their candidate/region association.
ranking_source_checks.coexistence: Original-region actions may compete with any one extra region; actions within the same region may compete. Actions from two different extra regions are excluded. Positive utility gap selects only the better-to-worse orientation and excludes self-pairs.
ranking_source_checks.legal_mask: Both actions must satisfy cached action_valid, as for legacy ranking supervision. This is the supervision-valid mask before the model's verification gate; it does not assert that every supervised regular action is currently eligible in deployed selection.
ranking_source_checks.target_and_reduction: A GT utility gap strictly greater than float32 .05 weights relu(.03 - predicted score gap). Reduction is weighted hinge sum divided by max(total positive gap weight, 1). No extra search cost or extra utility term is added here.
ranking_source_checks.gt_isolation: GT utility is used only in the supervised objective after model decisions. Decision inputs, select_actions, inference thresholds and verification are unchanged. Utility remains .7 current IoU + .3 mean three-future IoU - .1 wrong-update fraction; cached future labels remain frozen-C1 continuations.
ranking_source_checks.empty_pair_behavior: No valid ordered pair yields zero ranking loss.
ranking_source_checks.changed_objectives: Only ranking among the 13 reported loss components changes in pairwise mode. The other 12 component values remain identical for fixed inputs and outputs. Shared-parameter gradients may consequently change; no claim of unchanged optimization trajectories is made.

independent_cpu_checks.execution: Pure functions extracted from old and current source via AST; CPU tensors only. Actual cached label rows and synthetic bounded output tensors. No model construction, neural forward, autograd backward or optimizer by reviewer.

existing_main_agent_cpu_witness.provenance: Receipt and witness source inspected; this score-tensor backward witness was executed by the main agent, not by the reviewer.

trainer_and_runner.trainer_plumbing: action_ranking defaults to reference and is supplied consistently to initial validation, training, epoch validation and strict best-checkpoint reload validation. It is recorded by the existing args/config/checkpoint path.
trainer_and_runner.initialization: Existing seed42 cold initialization, frozen pretrained C1 and fresh optimizer. Full stage does not load M0 weights or corresponding old reference weights.
trainer_and_runner.checkpoint: Existing trainer retains best.pth by validation utility and verifies strict reload. Full online evaluation uses exactly that run's best.pth. No architecture/schema change or new evaluator flag is required.
trainer_and_runner.completion_markers: training_completed.txt follows successful trainer exit. For full, job_completed.txt follows successful full98 evaluation and CPU report; for M0 it follows successful trainer exit. set -euo pipefail prevents a failed stage from writing the later marker.
trainer_and_runner.full_evaluation: Existing LasHeR traingset full98 development split at /data/gb/outputs/c1_initial_seed42/split.json, seed42, unchanged selector and gate. CPU report compares GOLA baseline, C1, and corresponding existing reference-ranking search mode/prefix run.

queue.missing_marker_and_missing_old_tmux: Exit with failure; no cancellation, timeout restart, fallback or replacement of old run.
queue.memory_guard: After observing the old job marker, query the supplied physical GPU and require memory.used < 500 MiB. This is a single guard, not a memory wait loop: a busy GPU makes the queue exit without launching M0.
queue.launch: Only run_recoverability_pairwise.sh GPU MODE m0 PREFIX. No automatic full launch.
queue.full_launch_condition: Main agent must inspect all four actual M0 receipts for 1 epoch/4 updates, real trainability, frozen C1, strict reload and capacity before separately launching fresh full stages, as specified in plan.json.

metadata_crosscheck.actual_four_reference_fit_configs: Read-only inspection confirmed corresponding search mode/prefix, seed42, B256, epochs60, prefer-last902 TRAIN and shared128 VAL. Existing training receipts report240 updates and strict reload success.
metadata_crosscheck.reference_action_ranking_field: Absent in old configs because old source implements reference ranking; no claim of an explicitly stored old pairwise/reference CLI field.
metadata_crosscheck.runtime_state_at_independent_read: All four old full job completion markers were still absent; all eight planned pairwise M0/full output roots were absent. These are time-specific observations, not launch-time guarantees.
metadata_crosscheck.later_parent_report: At 01:58 CST the main agent reported selector_own full98/report complete and physical GPU3 at20 MiB. Reviewer did not repeat GPU/process monitoring; queue rechecks the actual marker and memory before launch.

interpretation_limits: Source PASS allows the specified M0 queues; it does not replace runtime completion, free-card or all-four-M0 gates and does not certify improved tracking.

The hinge is zero at a predicted pair score gap of exactly .03. Deployed replacement still requires its existing strict keep+.03 comparison and verification/availability conditions. Zero ranking loss is not a guarantee of action selection; no threshold change is proposed.
Pairwise supervision uses currently cached GT utility, including frozen-C1 future labels. It is not full own-policy future continuation and does not remove that teacher limitation.
Full98 results remain development evidence. Existing corresponding reference arms supply the matched comparison; no official-test or multiple-seed acceptance claim is introduced.
